name: smwgraphics-super-mario-maker-super-mario-world-bob-omb-new-goomba
title: Super Mario Maker: Super Mario World - Bob-Omb + New Goomba
description:
It bothers me how Super Mario Maker didn't give the bob-ombs wind ups yet SMB1 and 3 gave them one so I made them with one along with my own custom Goomba sprite to fit the game's style it also includes a squished sprite as well replacing the 5-up symbol. Here is a tutorial how to get the squashed Goomba GFX.
http://www.smwcentral.net/?p=viewthread&t=35765&page=1

You can also add your custom Goombas for the sprites too.

Parachute Goombas NOT INCLUDED!
